mapping_policy.abilities: Exact reviewed candidate evidence first; otherwise same reviewed communicative function.
mapping_policy.words: Reviewed lexical ownership to candidate cluster; grammar-owned words remain cross-cutting until grammar placement.
mapping_policy.phrases: Exact reviewed chunk match first; otherwise Oxford source-headword natural home. No fuzzy semantic matching.
mapping_policy.grammar: Exact EGP feature to reviewed grammar owner, then owner candidate clusters.
